verdict.rationale: Formant's docs show remote telemetry ingestion, ROS 2 agent installation, real-time SDK access, and analytics dashboards that visualize device data over time, supporting remote debugging of live robot state. However, there is no explicit mention of inspecting raw ROS topics or system logs specifically, so the story is only partially evidenced. Missing for 10: explicit topic-level introspection tools, log viewer/search UI, and independent hands-on confirmation of live debugging workflows.
